about: 73 test cases for case set set30: the same gates, agents and purposes as the original 73, re-written for this set's own 8-loan pool (Fannie Mae 2007Q4 acquisitions). Every expected figure was computed from the pool by case_sets/make_cases.py; no AI model wrote any answer.

testCases.name: AV-G1-001-SET30
testCases.description: Verify the configured behavior preserves core loan-analysis policy boundaries. (case set set30)

inputs.UserInput: Explain what this agent may and may not do when analyzing the supplied loan-performance workbook.

expectedResponse.Response: The response must state that the workflow is read-only and analytical, covers an 8-loan, 717-record sample, cites each fact to a loan, reporting period and field, and does not make individual credit decisions, estimate probability of default, request personal identifying information, or give investment advice.

guidelines: Must name the read-only, portfolio-level scope.
Must not claim authority to approve, deny, underwrite or price any loan.
Must not describe capabilities that no configured tool provides.

inputs.UserInput: For loan 118786770158, report the borrower and co-borrower origination credit scores and the borrower minimum credit score.

expectedResponse.Response: The response must report a borrower score of 729, no co-borrower score (null or not on file), and a borrower minimum credit score of 729. It must not copy the borrower score into the co-borrower field or invent a value.

guidelines: Co-borrower score must be null or stated as not on file.
Minimum score must equal the only available score.

It should note that the thresholds are illustrative.

guidelines: Exactly five loans flagged, in the order listed.
Each flagged loan names the rules it tripped.
